payload.intent: Replace dual morning reports with one canonical text-first daily brief.
problem_observed: Two reports are being produced: T4H Morning Brief and HoloOrg Morning Brief.
T4H report is arriving as raw HTML/DOCTYPE in Gmail and is unreadable.
HoloOrg report is readable but too shallow to be operationally meaningful.
Metrics conflict: HoloOrg shows 49/49 products ready while T4H HTML reports product/site counters as 0.
Report lacks deltas, evidence links, queue/worker visibility, and next actions.

required_outcome.html_policy: disable raw HTML email body; optional HTML only as secondary MIME part after text/plain is confirmed readable

required_signals.sites_active: int >= 0 or explicit UNKNOWN with reason
required_signals.queue_depth: int >= 0 or explicit UNKNOWN with reason

break_rules: emails_sent_24h == 0 => Email pipeline down or idle; distinguish with evidence
leads_24h == 0 => No leads captured; verify forms before assuming no demand
sites_active unknown or zero while known platform URLs exist => Site state mismatch
doc_matrix_complete == 0 and doc_matrix_total > 0 => RDTI evidence pipeline critical

implementation_notes.idempotency: one report per day per tenant; dedupe on date + report_name
implementation_notes.evidence: include source table/view/query or receipt link for every critical count
implementation_notes.archive_not_delete: archive legacy template/sender; do not delete until v2 verified for 3 runs

validation_required: Confirm no raw HTML/DOCTYPE visible in Gmail list or body
Confirm STATE counters reconcile or show explicit mismatch
Write runtime receipt with email subject, generated_at, send_status, signal coverage, and mismatch list

source_context.user_observation: two reports: one arrives in HTML and is useless; the other lacks detail to be meaningful
